label: FP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — The sink writes 'out' to the HTTP response. 'out' is derived from 'val' (a cookie value) via 'org.owasp.encoder.Encode.forHtml(val)' immediately before the sink. As demonstrated in Example 1, HTML encoding applied to user-controlled data at the sink constitutes effective mitigation, rendering the XSS vulnerability non-existent. The resolved sink value is the HTML-encoded string, which is safe for display.

evidence.note: User-controlled cookie value 'val' is HTML-encoded into 'out' before being written to the response writer.
Value 'val' originates from 'request.getCookies()' iteration, representing user-controlled input.
